seeded_failure.symptom: The developer user receives an AccessDenied error when attempting to run aws s3 ls, even though the Developers group has S3 read-only access.
seeded_failure.cause: An inline policy named BlockS3 with an explicit Deny for action s3:ListAllMyBuckets was attached directly to the developer user.
seeded_failure.fix: Delete the BlockS3 inline policy from the developer user account and retry the aws s3 ls command.
